instruction: A pudgy pill bug sewn as a segmented cushion, its eight overlapping fabric bands stitched with contrasting cream topstitching so it looks half-curled. The shell is dove-grey minky fleece, the underside soft heather-lilac, and tiny felt legs poke out in a neat row underneath. Embroidered dot eyes, slight seam puckering and visible fiber loft make the whole body read as squeezably soft.
